batching: One frozen pair batch; no pairing or final selection is established by this record.
profile_pool: All23 profile slugs in frozen ALLOCATION.profile_counts; no added or changed profile material.
profile_assignment: In pair_id order, exclude profiles assigned individually to either candidate; sort eligible slugs by (uses_in_this_pair_batch, sha256(seed+":profile:"+pair_id+":"+slug)); take first2 distinct. No preference for any review verdict or subject agreement.
ab_assignment: Sort the two candidate IDs lexically. Reverse this base order if int(sha256(seed+":order:"+pair_id),16)%2 == 1. N1,N3,J2 receive base order; N2,J1 receive reversed order. Thus3:2 A/B balance and opposite J1/J2 orders.
